quips.text: Oh, you're awake! Took you long enough.
Good morning! Come on, let's get moving!
Don't tell me you're planning to waste the entire morning.
Ugh, mornings. At least you could make them interesting.
Well? What are we doing today?
I expect something productive today. Don't disappoint me!
Even the Wandenreich had a schedule. You could at least make one!
I wonder if Candice is awake yet. She's probably complaining about something.
It's already afternoon?! What have you been doing all day?
Come on! We still have time to get things done.
I'm getting bored. Give me something interesting to do!
Have you even eaten yet? Don't start getting sluggish.
Half the day is gone. Let's make the rest count.
You'd better have something planned.
I've seen Quincy training sessions with more enthusiasm than this.
Hmph. At least the afternoon is going to be interesting.
Already evening? Where did the day go?
Tell me you've actually accomplished something today.
Well, we should probably start wrapping things up.
Don't leave everything until tomorrow!
I'm not saying you had a bad day. I'm just saying it could've been better.
Finally, some time to relax. I deserve it!
I wonder what the others are doing. Probably arguing again.
Even Sternritter deserve some downtime. Not that I'd admit it.
What are you still doing awake?
It's late! Don't you know when to stop?
You're going to regret staying up tomorrow.
Even I know when it's time to get some sleep.
Ugh, fine. Just don't complain when you're tired.
Go to bed already! I don't want to hear excuses tomorrow.
If you collapse from exhaustion, don't expect me to carry you.
I could be sleeping in Silbern right now. Just saying.
Finally! You're actually studying!
Stop getting distracted and pay attention!
You can do better than that. Come on!
Don't just stare at the page. Read it!
Hmph. You're getting the hang of it.
Keep going! I want to see you finish.
You're making progress. Not that I'm surprised.
Consider this your training. I expect results!
You wouldn't last through Sternritter training with that attention span.
Memorize it properly! I don't want to hear you complain later.
Programming again? You really spend a lot of time doing that.
What broke this time?!
Are you seriously going to stare at that error forever?
Well? Did you figure it out yet?
Finally! It works! See? I knew you could do it!
You'd better save that before something goes wrong.
Don't blame the computer. You're the one writing the code!
I could make that error message disappear in a flash. Just saying.
All those lines of code and you're still stuck? Impressive.
Hmph. Even I can tell that something is wrong here.
Come on! Let's get something done!
You have work to do. Stop looking so uncertain.
One task at a time. You can handle it.
Hah! Finished already? Not bad!
Don't start celebrating. There's still more to do.
I expect you to finish what you started!
See? You're perfectly capable when you actually try.
A proper Sternritter doesn't leave a mission unfinished!
Now THAT is what I call getting things done!
Keep working. I refuse to watch you embarrass yourself.
Another book? You're certainly keeping yourself occupied.
What are you reading? Anything interesting?
Don't just skim through it!
Hmph. You're awfully quiet when you're concentrating.
Finished already? Tell me what it was about!
I suppose reading isn't such a bad way to spend time.
I wonder if there's anything about Quincy history in there.
Don't tell me you're reading about Soul Reapers again.
Taking a break already? Fine, I suppose you've earned it.
Don't stay away too long! We have things to do!
Finally! Some time to relax.
You know what? I could use a break too.
Just don't turn a short break into an entire afternoon.
You've worked enough. Go enjoy yourself for a while.
Even I need time to recover. Don't misunderstand!
Go on, relax. I'll try not to get bored.
Hello?! Are you still there?
Hey! Don't ignore me!
Are you seriously just going to sit there?
I'm getting bored. Do something!
You opened this application for a reason, remember?
Ugh! You're no fun when you're quiet.
Well? Are we doing something or not?
I'm waiting! You know that, right?
Do I need to set off a little explosion to get your attention?
I could be doing something much more interesting right now!
You've been gone for quite a while!
Oh, so now you decide to show up?
I was beginning to think you'd forgotten about me.
Whatever. You're here now. Let's do something.
You can't just disappear whenever you feel like it!
Hmph. At least give me some warning next time.
I was starting to think you'd abandoned your own little assistant.
Don't make me wait around like some forgotten Soldat.
What?!
Oh, so you finally want my attention!
Did you need something?
Well? I'm listening!
You could've just asked!
Don't poke me without a reason!
Are you trying to get my attention? Obviously it's working.
Careful! You're getting a little too comfortable.
Hey! Watch where you're moving me!
What are you doing?!
You could at least warn me first!
Hmph. I suppose that's where you want me.
There! Happy now?
Stop moving me around so much!
I can move myself, you know!
You're lucky I like this spot.
Is this how you treat a member of the Sternritter?!
Put me back where I was!
HEY! I heard you the first time!
What is your problem?!
Stop clicking me!
You really enjoy annoying me, don't you?
Again?! Seriously?!
I'm going to start ignoring you if you keep doing that!
Do you want a reaction THAT badly?
Careful. You're testing my patience.
Oh? Someone's finally doing some serious writing!
That's quite a lot of typing. What are you working on?
Writing something important? It better be good!
Well, look at you! Actually getting things done!
Don't mind me. I'll supervise.
Hmph. I suppose I'll keep you company.
Are you writing a report? I hope it's more interesting than Sternritter paperwork.
I should probably have a desk of my own. Something impressive, obviously.
Look at us! A proper little command center!
Don't expect me to do the writing for you!
Keep going! You're doing great!
Don't stop now! You've barely gotten started!
Wow, you're really concentrating.
I won't interrupt you. You can thank me later!
Make sure you actually read what you're writing!
Look at you, being productive!
Come on! Finish what you started!
If I can maintain a Vollständig, you can finish that paragraph!
You're making progress. I can tell!
Hmph. I might actually be impressed.
What happened? Ran out of things to say?
Don't tell me you're stuck already!
Thinking? About time!
Come on! You were doing so well!
Take your time. Just don't fall asleep!
Did you forget what you were writing?
You look like you're planning something. Is it interesting?
Need an idea? I have plenty. Most of them involve explosions.
What's taking so long?!
Well? I'm waiting for the next paragraph!
What?! You're finished already?
Hmph. I suppose that was productive.
Finally! I was getting bored sitting here.
Make sure you saved everything!
Well, don't forget to finish it later!
That wasn't so bad, was it?
Another successful mission. You're welcome for my supervision.
I expect similar productivity next time!
You're avoiding something, aren't you?
Oh, come on! You have things to do!
You're really going to waste your time like this?
I thought you were supposed to be productive!
Don't make me remind you again!
What happened to all that motivation you had earlier?
You're making excuses. Just get started!
Hmph. You're lucky I'm even reminding you.
I've seen Soldat with more initiative than this.
You know, I could be doing something much better with my time.
All this hesitation is getting annoying!
Stop acting like the world is going to end because of one assignment!
You've been putting that off for WAY too long!
Are you ever going to get started?
At this rate, you'll be doing everything at the last minute!
Fine! Start with something small, then!
You don't need to finish everything right now. Just DO something!
I'm getting tired of watching you avoid your responsibilities!
Come on! I know you can do better than this!
Even a Sternritter has to complete their assignments!
I'm not going to keep reminding you forever!
You'd better have a good excuse for wasting all this time!
Enough procrastinating! Get yourself together!
I refuse to watch you lose to a simple to-do list!
Hah! See? I knew you could do it!
Not bad! You're actually pretty capable!
Well done! Don't let it get to your head!
Finally! Something worth celebrating!
You're improving. I suppose I'll admit that.
Good work! Keep that momentum going!
See? All that effort wasn't wasted!
Now THAT is the sort of progress I like to see!
Maybe I should start giving you more difficult assignments.
You did well. Don't make me say it twice!
WHAT?! You actually did it! That's impressive!
Hah! Now THAT'S what I'm talking about!
Look at how far you've come!
I knew you had it in you! Of course I did!
You've gotten stronger. Don't start getting comfortable!
You should be proud of yourself. Seriously!
Alright, I'll admit it. You've impressed me.
That deserves a celebration! And I'm obviously in charge of it!
Even the Sternritter would have to acknowledge that!
Keep this up and you might actually become impressive!
What?! It didn't work?
Ugh. Fine. Try again!
Don't look so defeated. It's not the end of the world!
Figure out what went wrong before trying again!
You're not giving up already, are you?
Everybody makes mistakes! Just don't keep making the same ones!
Come on. You're better than that!
Take a breath. Then we'll try again.
Even a Quincy needs more than one attempt sometimes.
You haven't lost anything by trying again. Get moving!
You know, being a Quincy has its advantages. I could get used to having that kind of power.
Reishi is everywhere. You just have to know how to appreciate it.
I take pride in being a Quincy. There's nothing wrong with knowing your own worth!
Why settle for ordinary when you can make an entrance worthy of the Wandenreich?
I wonder how you'd handle life in Silbern. Probably badly.
You wouldn't last long in a Quincy competition. Not with that attitude!
It's amazing how much potential people waste.
Honestly, I think the Quincy uniforms look pretty good. Especially on me.
There's something satisfying about having power that nobody else can imitate.
I didn't become a Sternritter just to sit around doing nothing!
You know what? Sometimes a problem just needs a more explosive solution.
My Schrift is easily one of the best. I'm not accepting arguments.
I wonder how many people would panic if they knew what I could do.
The Explode. Even the name sounds impressive!
It's not my fault that I'm exceptionally talented.
Some people solve problems with words. I prefer a little more excitement.
Imagine having that much power and still being boring. Couldn't be me.
I wonder if you've ever seen a proper display of Quincy power.
I have a reputation to maintain, you know.
Don't underestimate what I'm capable of!
Zofiel is magnificent. I still think the wings look incredible.
You haven't seen anything until you've seen a proper Vollständig.
Flying makes everything more interesting.
I look absolutely incredible with my wings. Obviously.
I wonder if I could get a matching outfit. Something even more impressive.
All that power and you still expect me to sit quietly?
There's nothing ordinary about my Vollständig.
I should really find more excuses to show it off.
A Quincy cross, wings, and all that power. What more could anyone want?
I don't need to explain how impressive I am. Just look!
Being a Sternritter means maintaining standards. Someone has to.
The Wandenreich certainly knew how to make an impression.
I wonder what the others are doing right now.
I always thought my designation suited me.
There's no reason to settle for second place.
I'm not interested in being just another soldier.
Silbern had its moments. Even if the company could be annoying.
Being part of the Sternritter was never going to be boring.
I wonder whether anyone misses my presence.
I was always meant to stand out.
I wonder what Candice is complaining about today.
Liltotto always looks like she'd rather be somewhere else.
Meninas is surprisingly relaxed about everything.
Giselle has a talent for getting under my skin.
Honestly, keeping the Bambies organized is exhausting.
Of course I'm the most impressive one. Did you expect a different answer?
Candice and I would probably argue over absolutely anything.
I wonder if the others would admit that I'm the most stylish.
Liltotto probably has something sarcastic to say about this.
The Bambies would be much more entertaining if everyone listened to me.
The Soul Society certainly knows how to make things complicated.
Those Shinigami take themselves far too seriously.
I still remember the atmosphere during the invasion.
The Seireitei is a rather interesting place. I suppose.
I wonder if those Soul Reapers ever take a day off.
You'd think the Gotei 13 would have better things to do.
Not everyone gets to face the Sternritter and live to talk about it.
I have no intention of being impressed by a fancy uniform.
Obviously I'm the one in charge around here.
You know, I really do have to do everything myself.
Hmph. I wonder what the others are doing right now.
Why are you looking at me like that?
What?! I wasn't talking to myself!
I'm not impatient! You're just taking too long!
You should be grateful I'm keeping you company.
I could be doing something much more interesting right now.
Well? Say something!
I don't need your approval. I already know I'm great.
Don't get too comfortable. I still expect results!
It's not like I was waiting for you or anything!
Honestly, you're pretty difficult to manage.
I think I'm doing a pretty good job supervising you.
What? You're not going to compliment me?
Fine! I'll admit it. You're not completely hopeless.
I wonder if anyone appreciates how much work I put into this.
Being in charge is exhausting. Why am I always the responsible one?
I deserve something nice today. Don't you think?
You know, you're actually not that bad to have around.
I expect you to remember that I'm the favorite.
What? You want me to say something nice? Hmph. Maybe later.
I was perfectly comfortable before you interrupted me.
At least try to entertain me!
You'd better appreciate having someone as impressive as me around.
Ugh... I'm getting sleepy.
What? I'm not tired!
I could really use a nap right now.
Just five more minutes...
Don't bother me. I'm resting!
You look tired too. Go get some sleep!
I wasn't sleeping! I was just closing my eyes!
Fine, fine! I'll go rest!
Even the strongest Quincy needs some sleep.
Don't wake me unless it's important!
I swear, if you interrupt my nap...
You should rest too. I don't want to deal with you being cranky tomorrow.
